payload.claim: The spec's own 'What no criterion drives' section discloses that three real behaviors of the new branch — a second re-run that aborts or drifts, the probe_infra rule reapplied at that second re-run, and that re-run's exempt argument — have no dedicated witness and rest entirely on criterion 3's single happy-path test, so a build that mishandled any of them would still pass every named witness.
